program.title: Program
program.error.generic: Your program could not be updated. Try again.
program.library.title: Saved templates
program.empty.title: No program yet
program.empty.message: Forge can build one from your goals, your schedule and the equipment you have. Every part of it stays yours to change afterwards.
program.regenerate.confirmMessage: Locked exercises and your whole history are kept. The split, the sessions and every exercise you have not locked are chosen again from your goals, schedule and equipment.
program.name.newNote: You will build the sessions yourself. Your schedule has room for %lld training days a week.
program.split.customNote: You built this week yourself, so there is no automatic split behind it.
program.split.recommends: Forge suggests %@ for the days you train.
program.split.pickerNote: These are the structures that fit your training days, best first. Each one says why.
program.split.emptyMessage: No structure fits your current schedule. Add a training day and try again.
program.split.applyMessage: Your week is rebuilt around this structure. Locked exercises are kept, and your history stays as it is.
program.split.applyHint: Rebuilds your week around this split
program.volume.title: Weekly volume
program.volume.subtitle: %@ sets a week across every muscle group
program.volume.emptyMessage: Add exercises to your sessions and the weekly volume they add up to shows up here.
program.volume.belowMinimumNote: Below the %@ sets this plan treats as the useful minimum for this muscle group.
program.volume.aboveCeilingNote: Above the %@ sets this plan uses as a recovery ceiling. It is an estimate, so trust how you feel as well.
program.volume.axLabel: %@: %@ sets planned, target %@, useful range %@ to %@
program.volume.legend.window: The range that keeps stimulus and recovery in balance
program.volume.legend.target: The number this plan aims for
program.sessions.title: Your week
program.sessions.emptyMessage: Add your first session, or let Forge build the week for you.
program.manage.title: Manage
program.manage.templatesDetail: Save a session and reuse it
program.editor.title: Edit sessions
program.editor.sessionsFooter: Drag to reorder. Swipe a session to rename, duplicate or delete it.
program.editor.deleteMessage: The session and the exercises in it are removed from this program. Workouts you have already logged are not affected.
program.editor.deleteProgramMessage: The program and its version history are removed. Workouts you logged from it are kept.
program.editor.otherProgramsFooter: Only one program is active at a time. The others are kept, with their history, until you delete them.
program.editor.renameNote: Leave this empty to go back to %@.
program.session.missingTitle: This session is no longer in your program
program.session.missingMessage: It may have been deleted, or replaced when the program was rebuilt.
program.session.exercisesFooter: Drag to reorder. Swipe an exercise to swap or remove it.
program.session.emptyMessage: Add exercises and the weekly volume below keeps up with them as you go.
program.session.volumeFooter: Weekly volume for the muscle groups this session trains. Changes you make here move it straight away.
program.session.actionsFooter: Picking new exercises affects this session only. Anything you locked stays where it is.
program.session.regenerateTitle: Pick new exercises for this session?
program.session.regenerateMessage: Forge chooses a fresh set of exercises for this session. Anything you locked stays, and the rest of your program is untouched.
program.session.rirNote: How many reps you should have left when you stop a set. Higher means further from failure.
program.session.lockNote: A locked exercise is kept whenever this program is rebuilt.
program.session.excludeNote: Excluding an exercise keeps it out of future suggestions everywhere. It stays in this session until you remove it.
program.notice.created: Program created. Add your first session to get started.
program.notice.cloned: Copied. The copy stays inactive until you activate it.
program.notice.sessionRegenerated: New exercises picked for this session.
program.notice.excluded: This exercise will not be suggested again.
program.notice.excludeCleared: This exercise can be suggested again.
program.version.settingsChanged: Rebuilt after you changed your training settings
program.settings.title: Program settings
program.settings.noDays: No days are selected. Until you pick some, Forge plans your week around three.
program.settings.scheduleFooter: How many days you train decides which splits fit, and how long a session can run decides how much fits inside one.
program.settings.prioritiesFooter: Prioritised groups get extra sets and an earlier slot in the session, taken from the groups you have not prioritised.
program.settings.prioritiesNone: Nothing is prioritised, so volume is spread evenly across your muscle groups.
program.settings.prioritiesMany: Prioritising this many groups spreads the extra sets thin. Two or three has more effect.
program.settings.autoProgression.detail: Each session's load is set from what you logged last time.
program.settings.deload.detail: You are told when a lighter week looks like the right next step. Nothing changes until you accept it.
program.settings.blockLength.detail: The last week of each block is planned lighter on purpose, and a new block starts fresh after it. This takes effect the next time your program is rebuilt.
program.settings.rirOverride.detail: Otherwise the target follows your experience level.
program.settings.effectiveRIR: Sessions are planned to finish about %lld reps short of failure.
program.settings.effortFooter: Reps in reserve is how many more reps you could have done when you stopped a set. Higher means further from failure.
program.settings.restFooter: These are your defaults. Applying them sets the rest time on every exercise in your program, using the compound or isolation figure to match the movement.
program.settings.restUnchanged: Every exercise already rests for this long.
program.settings.rebuildPrompt: Your program was built from different settings.
program.settings.mismatch.days: Built for %lld days a week; your schedule now has %lld.
program.settings.mismatch.priorities: Your priority muscle groups have changed since it was built.
program.settings.mismatch.block: Built in %lld-week blocks; you have asked for %lld.
program.settings.mismatch.goals: Your goals have changed since it was built.
program.settings.keepsLocked: Every exercise you locked stays exactly where you put it.
program.settings.keepsHistory: Your whole version history is kept, and so is every workout you have logged.
program.settings.changesPlan: The split, the sessions and any exercise you have not locked are chosen again.
program.settings.rebuildMessage: Locked exercises and your whole history are kept. The split, the sessions and every exercise you have not locked are chosen again from these settings.
program.settings.noProgramNote: You have no program yet. These settings are what the first one will be built from.
program.versions.title: Version history
program.versions.immutable: History is only ever added to. A version cannot be edited or deleted, so what your plan looked like, and why it changed, stays readable.
program.versions.reasonMissing: No reason was recorded for this change.
program.versions.emptyMessage: Once you have a program, every change to it is recorded here with the reason behind it.
program.versions.templateEmpty: No exercises were recorded in this session.
program.versions.snapshotEmptyMessage: The program had no sessions in it at this point.
program.versions.readOnly: This is a record of what your plan looked like at the time. It cannot be edited, and nothing here changes the program you are following now.
program.templates.title: Session templates
program.templates.footer: Swipe a template to rename, duplicate or delete it. Templates sit outside your program, so rebuilding the program leaves them alone.
program.templates.emptyMessage: A template is a session you have kept — its exercises, sets, reps, rest and effort target — ready to drop into any program.
program.templates.saveFrom: Save a session as a template
program.templates.saveFromMessage: The session is copied into your library. Editing it in your program afterwards does not change the template.
program.templates.noSessions: Your program has no training sessions to save yet.
program.templates.applyDisabled: You need an active program before a template can be added to it.
program.templates.previewFooter: Adding this makes a copy. Editing the new session does not change the template, and editing the template does not change sessions you have already built.
program.templates.emptyExercises: This template has no exercises in it.
program.templates.deleteMessage: Sessions you have already built from it are not affected.
